description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis represents different language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Inde, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis measures the effect, with a scale ranging from approximately -5 to 35. The chart includes four sets of bars, each representing a different model: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, and XLM-R2. Each set of bars is color-coded, with mBERT-L2 in light blue, XLM-L2 in dark blue, mBERT-R2 in green, and XLM-R2 in red. The bars show the effect of context masking on case tasks for each language family, with error bars indicating the standard deviation. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting of the bars or any visual emphasis on specific bars.
